subject: Novaterra — request to pause Redwood demo while Q3 product sprint completes
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@novaterra.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaterra Product Team <product@novaterra.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 15:02:12 -0700
Subject: Quick update on next week's Redwood demo

Hi Grace,

Quick update from our side — we're going to need to pull the demo next week and ask for a short pause. Two things came up on our end: the product org had an unexpected shift to a Q3 launch cadence and the CTO will be traveling for the next three weeks, so the key stakeholders won't be available to evaluate.

High level:
- Product sprint pulled engineering and data resources (analytics-first launch)
- Budget review pushed LLM/inference spend to a later cycle
- CTO travel + leadership reviews mean demo attendees won't be the decision makers next week

We're still interested in Redwood; this is timing/priority rather than a 'no'. Would you be open to pausing active work and setting a check-in for ~6–8 weeks? Also two quick asks: if we pause, can you confirm there are no active billing commitments and whether we can retain the demo environment (read-only access) for a short period? Finally, if there's a small courtesy credit available (pilot access), that would help keep things warm.

Apologies for the short notice — happy to sync on alternatives if you prefer to keep the slot and include a smaller internal group.

Thanks,
Samantha
Product Director, Novaterra

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@novaterra.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 16:18:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick update on next week's Redwood demo

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and totally understand the timing hit. Appreciate you being candid about where things sit.

Options we can do immediately:
1) Pause the active demo and move to a check-in in 6–8 weeks (we'll mark the POC as "on hold" in our CRM).
2) Keep a lightweight read-only preview environment available for your team (no charge) so product/engineering can review internals when they have a window.
3) If you want, we can do a short 20–30 minute asynchronous walkthrough recorded for the stakeholders who are traveling.

On your asks: no active billing commitments — we won't spin up paid Dedicated capacity until you explicitly sign the pilot/order. I'm attaching a short mutual action plan that documents milestones and the pause option so you can share it with leadership. We can also offer two weeks of hosted access (no usage charge) to keep test tokens around while you're paused.

If that sounds reasonable, I'll:
- Mark the opportunity as "on hold" and set a follow-up reminder for 2028-06-21
- Send over the short pause summary (attached) for your records
- Offer a timeslot for an asynchronous recording if you'd like one

Let me know which of the three options you prefer and if the two-week courtesy access works for you.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@novaterra.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaterra Product Team <product@novaterra.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick update on next week's Redwood demo

Hi Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround. We'd like to go with option 1 + 2: pause the active demo and keep the read-only preview environment available. The two-week hosted courtesy access is a generous offer and should help us keep momentum.

One follow-up: our security lead asked whether you can confirm basic data-handling expectations during the pause (retention of logs, access controls, SOC 2 evidence). If you can include a short note on that, I can include it in the leadership summary.

I'll share the MAP with the wider leadership group and confirm the follow-up date. Appreciate the flexibility.

Thanks,
Samantha

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@novaterra.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick update on next week's Redwood demo

Perfect — we'll proceed with pause + read-only preview and the two-week courtesy hosted access. Quick note we can share with your security lead:
- Access: preview environment will be restricted to named Novaterra users only (we'll enforce SSO where configured).
- Logs & retention: no production logs will be provisioned during the preview; any activity is limited to demo telemetry and is retained for 30 days unless you request deletion sooner.
- Compliance: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II and can provide the standard attestations; we won't transfer customer data into Dedicated capacity during the pause.

I'll copy this note into the MAP attachment and send a short "pause confirmation" email for you to surface to leadership. Also looping in Vivek to line up the short benchmarking session (no-charge) we offered — we can run that in the week after your stakeholders are back if helpful.

Grace
---
(Internal note: mark NV-7831 as "on hold" in HubSpot; propose a 2028-06-21 check-in. Offering: 2 weeks hosted courtesy + 1 no-charge benchmarking session. Send formal pause confirmation doc.)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 May 2028 09:34:07 -0700
Subject: Internal follow-up: Novaterra paused — proposed next steps

Vivek / Lauren — FYI thread with Samantha at Novaterra. They moved the demo to "on hold" due to a Q3 analytics-first sprint and CTO travel. They accepted our pause + read-only preview approach and the two-week courtesy access.

Proposed internal actions:
- Mark deal NV-7831 as on_hold in HubSpot, add note: "Product sprint — check-in 2028-06-21"
- Send formal pause confirmation (use attached MAP as the basis) and include the brief security note for leadership
- Approve offering: 2 weeks free hosted access + 1 free benchmarking session; confirm with finance if we need pre-approval for pilot credits (likely under $500 usage cap)
- Schedule an 8-week automated check-in task rather than continuous outreach; move to nurture cadence (monthly thought leadership + a short product update in 6 weeks)

If you approve, I'll: update HubSpot, send the pause confirmation to Samantha, and create the calendar follow-up for 2028-06-21. If finance wants a formal credit memo I can draft it.

Grace
